question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (ego_right): This image was captured from a wrist-mounted camera on the robot's right arm.


Image 2 (ego_left): This image shows the manipulation from the robot's left arm camera viewpoint.


Image 3 (fix_center): This perspective shows the manipulation task from the center of the camera setup.


A robotic task is captured from multiple camera perspectives in these images.
One frame was acquired at a distinct temporal moment, creating a timing discrepancy.
Look for visual cues including illumination changes, spatial object relationships, and robot pose variations.
Select the image number that demonstrates temporal misalignment.
